description: This file defines a PHP class for rendering a plus-shaped marker in a graph, extending a base marker class. It includes methods for drawing the marker on a canvas with configurable thickness.

classes.name: Image_Graph_Marker_Plus
classes.description: A class representing a plus-shaped data marker for graph rendering, extending the base marker class.

methods.name: _drawMarker
methods.description: Draws a plus-shaped marker on the canvas at specified (x, y) position, with optional data values.
